spans.s:
Dulcet,Ⓒa.Ⓓsurasa, svAdu, maDura, mizwa; ‘d(ulcet) to the ear’ suKaSrava, susvara, Srutimanohara.
ⓃDulcify,Ⓒv. t.ⒹmaDurIkf 8 U, svAdUkf.

Dull,Ⓒa.ⒹmaMda, mUQa, jaqa, maMda-sTUla-budDi-mati; ‘d(ull)-witted’ durmati, jaqamati, maMdaDI.
Ⓑ
 2 nizpraBa, vizaRRa, nistejas, nirutsAha, klAMta, mlAna, maMdacCAya, malina, maMdadyuti.
Ⓑ
 3 atIkzRa, DArAhIna, atejas, kuMWa.
Ⓑ
 4 alasa, maMTara, jaqa, maMdagati, maMda anuzRa, SItaka, tuMdaparimfja.
Ⓑ
 5 sTUla, Gana.
Ⓑ
 6 arasa, arasika.
Ⓑ
 7 kazwakara (rI f.), vizama, nirAnaMda; ‘d(ull) of hearing’ vikalakarRa; ‘a d(ull) day’ durdinaM, tamovftaM naBaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹjaqIkf 8 U, muh c., kuW 10, atIkzRIkf, GanIkf, nizpraBIkf, tejo hf 1 P; vi-zad c., mlAnIkf, utsAhaM BaMj 7 P.
Ⓝ[Dull]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹmAMdyaM, jAqyaM, mUQatA; atIkzRatA, AlasyaM, tejomAMdyaM, nizpraBatA, atejas n., &c.
